integrity: The exact identity is algebraic; the asymptotic result is proved using uniform Stirling remainders and a quartically flat central profile. Finite computations are supplemental regression checks only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the binary leave-one-out regime.
The maximizing integer is localized asymptotically but no exact finite-N rounding rule is claimed.
Equivalent older formulations under finite-population approximation terminology remain a residual literature risk.
title: Mesoscopic symmetry breaking in leave-one-out hypergeometric/binomial divergence
